properties.name: Petőfiváros I.
properties.method: Manual source-black-outline interpretation on the exact original embedded2021 municipal figure79 JPEG. Manually selected source-stroke seeds guide connected dark source-pixel paths; every dense vertex is an actual source pixel(maxRGB45) and every step is an8-neighbor source-pixel step. Only strictly collinear vertices are compressed. A frozen affine transform fitted to five exact contemporary OSM-node coordinates and manually located image junctions georeferences the historical illustration. No current-road substitution, generated closing chord, gap bridge, snapping of geographic geometry, buffer, repair or inferred extent.
properties.sourcePeriod: Municipal publication2021May; underlying orthophoto acquisition date unknown.

sourceRaster.pixelCoordinateConvention: integer PIL source-pixel indices, x right/y down, top-left index0; no halfpixel offset added

reviewNotes: These are the actual separately labelled fine outlines on figure79, not the broad combined Petőfiváros–Felsőszéktó planning extent.
Every dense trace vertex is a black pixel in the unmodified original JPEG. Geographic vertices derive from image georeferencing and MUST NOT be described as original OSM vertices.
Contemporary OSM nodes only supply geographical control coordinates; the manually placed old-image junction locations and the map line width have unknown positional uncertainty.
The current Vízmű arterial is displaced from part of the historical source outline; it is not substituted for the black source line.
Fit residuals describe chosen control consistency, not absolute map/boundary accuracy. No official/current/legal/cadastral or address assignment is established.
properties.license: Municipal source-map reuse rights not independently established; ODbL applies to OSM geographical controls.
properties.attribution: Source: Kecskemét MJV Megalapozó VizsgálatII2021, figure79; geographical controls ©OpenStreetMap contributors.
